name: Terra Fighters
detailed_description:
🌍 Terra Fighters

The world is your weapon in this earth-slinging platform fighter where mighty champions defend their homelands from global chaos!

Terra Fighters is a 2D local multiplayer fighting game where unique defenders from every continent battle it out in fast-paced, king-of-the-hill-style matches.

🐾 Friendly Fire, Global Fun

Knock your friends into the water below in a wild, earth-throwing showdown. Like a snowball fight meets platform chaos, with the stage crumbling beneath your feet. Pick up the blocks (Terra) you're standing on and hurl them at opponents.

Combo your attacks with projectiles that orbit the arena and come back from behind, catching opponents off guard from the far side of the fight.

  • Avoid the edge—fall off the stage and you're out!

  • Deflect incoming projectiles and bounce them back for a clutch counter.

  • Watch your back—curveball attacks can circle the globe and strike from behind!

🌎 Eight Defenders. One Fragile Earth.

Each fighter defends their homeland with pride and personality. Every fighter starts with a signature special block that blast their opponent — teleport traps, ice freezes, or explosive blasts.

  • Fall in love with each proud fighter and their beautiful homeland.

  • Arenas are set across the globe, with dynamic hazards like lightning strikes, moving platforms, and timed destruction that keep matches unpredictable.

  • More unlockable characters in the game.

📖 Story Mode: One Hero’s Journey to Unravel a Global Crisis.

Follow Kifaru, the stoic yet noble rhino warrior from Africa, as he sets out to investigate a mysterious global disturbance shaking the very foundations of the planet.

  • Face off against each regional fighter to earn their respect—and their help.

  • Discover the secrets behind the natural disasters threatening every continent.

  • Uncover a shocking twist at the heart of the chaos.

  • Each victory brings a new ally and takes Kifaru one step closer to the truth.

👊 Local Showdowns

Whether you’re in it for the laughs, the strategy, or the world-saving adventure, Terra Fighters delivers explosive fun for up to 2 players. Battle friends in couch PvP or play solo and see how far your skills—and your squad—can take you.

Protect your home. Save the world—one Terra at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • Storage: 60 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-650 / AMD A10-5800K
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 / Radeon HD 7510
  • Storage: 60 MB available space
